schedule.headline: Plain English: Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)
schedule.body: "Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)" just means making sure AI tools like ChatGPT and Google's AI answers can find and understand your business when someone asks a question. That's the whole definition. Marketing didn't need to make that hard.

schedule.headline: Plain English: Conversion rate
schedule.body:
Plain English: "Conversion rate"

Every agency will tell you that you need it. Almost none explain what it actually is.

It just means: how many people who visit your page actually do the thing you wanted them to do.

That's the whole thing.

Happy Hunter Digital — Pretoria.
